entities.summary: Archive, written on clay tablets, primarily consisting of diplomatic correspondence between the egyptian administration and its representatives in canaan and amurru during the new kingdom. Amarna letters is a archaeological artefact. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
